verdict.rationale: The public CIPO site links to an 'Integrated circuit topography registration, fees and forms' page and to how-to-file instruction pages for patents and trademarks, which suggests some forms and guidance are reachable on the open site. The main filing paths, however, are presented as online services or account logins (MyCIPO Patents), and no item explicitly confirms that downloadable forms exist without an account. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of downloadable (e.g. PDF) forms for trademarks, patents and copyright, confirmation that they need no account, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
